sentences.text: The dechlorinated refill bucket sits under the sink, labeled in Sharpie so no substitute teacher pours straight tap water again. Flakes drifted everywhere while gravel crunched across the counter and one triumphant kindergartner held the net upside down. "He's not dead, he's sleeping," Tomas announced, though Ms. Reyes quietly moved the net closer just in case. Per the laminated rota taped beside the aquarium, Thursday feeding duties belong to Table Four, not to whoever arrives first. Nobody volunteered to take the goldfish home over spring break until Dev's mom finally texted a reluctant yes. Every afternoon the sun slides across the pet corner, and Bubbles follows the bright stripe along the glass, nose to the warmth. Day nine: orange one hides behind the plastic castle whenever the recorder plays; possibly coincidence, possibly excellent taste. Somebody returned the Thanksgiving sign-up sheet with three names crossed out and a suspicious smear of orange marker. Next week the fourth graders will chart Peach's growth in centimeters against the flake rations recorded on the clipboard. Over the long weekend the filter hummed alone in Room 12, and Principal Vance stopped by twice with the spare key. Water temperature logged at 21 degrees Celsius during morning observations; nitrate strips remain in the science cupboard behind the beakers. Marisol swears Bubbles recognizes her, though Mr. Delgado keeps saying goldfish memory is longer than three seconds, actually. When the heater tripped the breaker in January, the whole feeding rota got rewritten around emergency thermometer checks. "Two pinches, not a fistful, Jayden — you'll cloud the whole bowl again." Why does Sir Finley only swim clockwise after lunch, and can we graph that for the science fair? "Who fed Nugget twice?" Ms. Okafor asked, holding up the flake canister with its lid already loose. "Do fish get bored?" Amara wrote at the top of her hypothesis sheet before recess even started. Honestly, half the class only lines up early on Mondays because whoever's first gets to sprinkle breakfast for Sushi. During Friday's lesson on habitats, the class measured how quickly Goldie surfaces when the fluorescent lights flick on. Gaps in the observation notebook appear every Wednesday, matching Room 12's rotation to the computer lab exactly. Between setups, the driver — a retired REME mechanic — explained the clutch to three fascinated extras. Each armored prop carries a fire extinguisher bolted inside the hull, hidden from every camera angle. The prop master wiped diesel off the Sherman's glacis plate before the lens got anywhere near it. Rain had streaked the fake mud on the hull, so the art department mixed another batch of fuller's earth. Production has confirmed that both armored vehicles were rented from a private collector under a strict no-live-fire agreement. A camera car kept pace with the rolling column, its stabilized arm floating over the lead vehicle's turret. Tomorrow we'll shoot the river crossing, so the effects team is waterproofing every hull seam tonight. Actors in crew uniforms lounged on the rear deck between takes, smoking herbal cigarettes the armorer had approved. Stunt rehearsal ran long: six hatch exits before anyone was allowed to touch the ignition. I spent an hour aging the stenciled divisional insignia so it would read as 1944 on camera. By noon the column had rolled through the village set four times, and the cobblestones were starting to crack. Video village erupted when the drone shot caught all five vehicles cresting the ridge in perfect echelon. Continuity flagged a modern valve stem visible on the lead vehicle's road wheel; grips taped over it. "Cut — the second Sherman drifted out of frame again," the first AD barked into her radio. Safety briefing at 0600: nobody walks within three meters of moving tracks, no exceptions, not even the director. Someone chalked the actor's mark directly onto the hull, and continuity made them photograph it before wiping. At wrap, the armorer counted every blank round back into its case while the hulls ticked and cooled. Her uniform was three sizes too big, standard issue for a background artist playing a loader. "Turret traverse is manual on this one, love, so give me a slow count of five," the prop master said. You learn fast that an eighty-year-old gearbox doesn't care about the shooting schedule. What is the meaning of the word tank?
